title: Preparation and hydrogen storage capacity of templated and activated carbons nanocast from commercially available zeolitic imidazolate framework
material_description: BF-900 | ZIF-templated carbon: furfuryl alcohol infiltrated into Basolite Z1200 (ZIF-8, Sigma-Aldrich) template, polymerised 80 °C 24 h then 150 °C 6 h under Ar, carbonised at 900 °C for 8 h under Ar (3 °C min-1); template removed during carbonisation
source_location: main article PDF p.5 (journal p.150), Fig. 6a, series BF-900 (green down-triangles)
notes: archive: fig6a_BF-900.json. Marker count = markers resolved on the plot; markers below ca. 1.3 bar overlap and are not counted. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). wt% calculated by the authors 'on the basis of a density of 1.5 g cm-3 for the carbon samples and a density of 0.04 g cm-3 for the hydrogen'; uptake basis and buoyancy correction not named; no saturation reached up to 20 bar. BET range: P/Po 0.06–0.22. Total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated; NLDFT pore-size maxima 8/15/20 Å printed (no single average diameter, field left empty). Degassed 200 °C and 10^-10 bar (printed; 1e-5 Pa) for 4–6 h (printed range, duration field left empty). H2 purity 99.9999% (printed). Residual mass at 1000 °C (TGA in air) ca. 11.5 wt%, attributed by the authors to incomplete removal of Zn (residual ZIF template); residual_metal_wt_pct left empty because the residual mass is not stated as Zn wt%. C: same plotted marker as B row HYC-0066-M1 (B: 1.5285 bar, 1.5052 wt%, archive Fig6a_BF-900.json; A: 1.4839 bar, 1.4990 wt%, archive fig6a_BF-900.json); code left them unmatched because the digitized pressures differ by more than 2%; value and pressure are the mean, uncertainty max(half difference, 1% of axis span). C (reconciliation): basis_inferred = excess and calibration_described = true because the stated density inputs of the wt% calculation (1.5 g cm-3 carbon, 0.04 g cm-3 hydrogen) are read as the gravimetric buoyancy correction; skeletal_density_g_cm3 = 1.5 is that assumed carbon density, not a measured He density; pore_volume_method = other (total pore volume single-point N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated); areal_uptake_g_cm2 left empty (Table 1 'H2 uptake density' is uptake per BET area, not an areal uptake of a film); isotherm_point_count = markers resolvable in Fig. 6, a lower bound because the low-pressure markers overlap. material_class = composite: the authors attribute BF-900's lower area and pore volume to 'a significant amount of residual ZIF template (i.e., Zn)'.
extractor: dual extraction A (claude-sonnet-5-5) and B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)

source_location: main article PDF p.5 (journal p.150), Fig. 6a, series BF-1050 (blue squares)
notes: archive: fig6a_BF-1050.json. Marker count = markers resolved on the plot; markers below ca. 1.3 bar overlap and are not counted. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). wt% calculated by the authors 'on the basis of a density of 1.5 g cm-3 for the carbon samples and a density of 0.04 g cm-3 for the hydrogen'; uptake basis and buoyancy correction not named; no saturation reached up to 20 bar. BET range: P/Po 0.06–0.22. Total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated; NLDFT pore-size maxima 5/15/20 Å printed (no single average diameter, field left empty). Degassed 200 °C and 10^-10 bar (printed; 1e-5 Pa) for 4–6 h (printed range, duration field left empty). H2 purity 99.9999% (printed). TGA residual mass ca. 2 wt% (stated for 1000, 1050 and 1100 °C samples; described as virtually ZIF/Zn free). C: value, pressure and digitization uncertainty are the mean of the A and B digitizations of this marker (B: HYC-0066-M32, archive in second/digitizations), uncertainty max(half difference, 1% of axis span). C (reconciliation): basis_inferred = excess and calibration_described = true because the stated density inputs of the wt% calculation (1.5 g cm-3 carbon, 0.04 g cm-3 hydrogen) are read as the gravimetric buoyancy correction; skeletal_density_g_cm3 = 1.5 is that assumed carbon density, not a measured He density; pore_volume_method = other (total pore volume single-point N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated); areal_uptake_g_cm2 left empty (Table 1 'H2 uptake density' is uptake per BET area, not an areal uptake of a film); isotherm_point_count = markers resolvable in Fig. 6, a lower bound because the low-pressure markers overlap.
extractor: dual extraction A (claude-sonnet-5-5) and B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)

activation_method: KOH activation, carbon/KOH weight ratio 1:4, 700 °C for 1 h under N2 flow (3 °C min-1); washed three times with 2 M HCl then distilled water to neutral pH; dried 120 °C 3 h
source_location: main article PDF p.5 (journal p.150), Fig. 6b, series ACBF-1100 (black crosses)
notes: archive: fig6b_ACBF-1100.json. Marker count = markers resolved on the plot; markers below ca. 1.3 bar overlap and are not counted. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). wt% calculated by the authors 'on the basis of a density of 1.5 g cm-3 for the carbon samples and a density of 0.04 g cm-3 for the hydrogen'; uptake basis and buoyancy correction not named; no saturation reached up to 20 bar. BET range: P/Po 0.06–0.22. Total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated; NLDFT pore-size maxima 8/13/21 Å printed (no single average diameter, field left empty). Degassed 200 °C and 10^-10 bar (printed; 1e-5 Pa) for 4–6 h (printed range, duration field left empty). H2 purity 99.9999% (printed). Black cross markers are thin and low-resolution; digitized with a dark-pixel mask of the page image (see log.md), lower confidence. C: value, pressure and digitization uncertainty are the mean of the A and B digitizations of this marker (B: HYC-0066-M125, archive in second/digitizations), uncertainty max(half difference, 1% of axis span). C (reconciliation): basis_inferred = excess and calibration_described = true because the stated density inputs of the wt% calculation (1.5 g cm-3 carbon, 0.04 g cm-3 hydrogen) are read as the gravimetric buoyancy correction; skeletal_density_g_cm3 = 1.5 is that assumed carbon density, not a measured He density; pore_volume_method = other (total pore volume single-point N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated); areal_uptake_g_cm2 left empty (Table 1 'H2 uptake density' is uptake per BET area, not an areal uptake of a film); isotherm_point_count = markers resolvable in Fig. 6, a lower bound because the low-pressure markers overlap.
extractor: dual extraction A (claude-sonnet-5-5) and B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)
